entities.name: Power of One
entities.description: The 7 main financial levers that affect cash flow. A 1% or one-day change to each lever compounds to dramatically improve operating cash flow.

entities.name: Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC)
entities.description: The time it takes to convert investments in inventory and other resources into cash flows from sales. Measures AR Days + Inventory Days - AP Days.

entities.name: Rockefeller Habits
entities.description: A set of 10 foundational habits for scaling a business, including daily huddle, weekly meeting rhythms, priorities, data, and scoreboards.

entities.name: 4D Framework
entities.description: The Gazelles framework organized around the 4 Decisions every leader must address: People, Strategy, Execution, and Cash.

entities.name: Brand Promise
entities.description: The 3 key promises a company makes to its core customers that differentiate it from competitors (e.g., Southwest: Low Fares, Lots of Flights, Lots of Fun).

entities.name: Big Hairy Audacious Goal (BHAG)
entities.description: A 10-to-25-year aspirational goal that provides constant context for all decisions throughout the organization. Concept from Jim Collins.

entities.name: One-Page Strategic Plan (OPSP)
entities.description: The best-known Gazelles tool driving alignment, accountability, and focus. 7 columns answering Who, What, When, Where, How, Why, Should/Shouldn't.

entities.name: Profit per X
entities.description: The key economic driver / fundamental metric that determines profitability per unit of the critical constraint (e.g., profit per customer, profit per employee).

entities.name: Core Customers
entities.description: The specific customer segment the company serves best, for whom the 3 Brand Promises are designed and kept.

entities.name: Core Values
entities.description: The handful of rules defining the company culture, reinforced through People (HR) systems on a daily basis.

entities.name: Core Purpose
entities.description: The deeper 'why' behind the company's existence — what difference it makes in the world. A better word for 'mission.'

entities.name: SWT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Trends)
entities.description: An augmented SWOT that explores broader external trends beyond one's own industry. Prevents inside/industry myopia.

entities.name: 7 Strata of Strategy
entities.description: Seven components of a robust strategy: words, sandbox, brand promises, KPIs, X-factor, profit-per-X, BHAG.

entities.name: Topgrading
entities.description: A hiring methodology for interviewing and selecting A-player talent, using structured scorecards and deep reference checks.

entities.name: Lean
entities.description: Management practice invented by Toyota focused on streamlining and speeding up processes, eliminating waste.

entities.name: FACe (Function Accountability Chart)
entities.description: Lists the key functions (seats) all organizations must fill, with person accountable, leading KPIs, and outcomes. Gets the right butts in the right seats.

entities.name: PACe (Process Accountability Chart)
entities.description: Maps the 4-9 core processes that drive the company, with person accountable, process name, and 3 KPIs (better, faster, cheaper).

entities.name: OPPP (One-Page Personal Plan)
entities.description: Mirrors the OPSP for personal life: Relationships, Achievements, Rituals, Wealth — aligning with People, Strategy, Execution, Cash.

entities.name: Vision Summary
entities.description: A simplified one-page OPSP for companies just getting started or those with 50 or fewer employees. Communicates vision easily.

entities.name: Topgrading Interview
entities.description: A structured chronological interview covering every role in the candidate's career, with scorecard and thorough reference checks.

entities.name: WWW (Who, What, When)
entities.description: At the end of weekly meetings, summarize Who said they'll do What, When. Drives clarity in communication and accountability.

entities.name: Revenue per Employee
entities.description: A key productivity metric measuring total revenue divided by number of employees, indicating operational efficiency.

entities.name: Net Promoter Score (NPS)
entities.description: Customer loyalty metric based on how likely customers are to recommend the company. Scored from -100 to +100.

entities.name: Cash Conversion Cycle Days
entities.description: Number of days cash is tied up in the operating cycle: AR Days + Inventory Days - AP Days.

entities.name: Gross Margin
entities.description: Revenue minus cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage. A fundamental profitability metric.

entities.name: KPI (Key Performance Indicator)
entities.description: Quantifiable measures used to evaluate success. Leading indicators for daily/weekly activities driving results.

entities.name: Daily Huddle (15 min)
entities.description: A 15-minute daily stand-up meeting to align the team, share priorities, and surface issues. Rockefeller Habit cornerstone.

entities.name: Weekly Meeting (90 min)
entities.description: A 90-minute weekly executive meeting focused on reviewing KPIs, priorities, customer feedback, and one major topic.

entities.name: Quarterly Planning (off-site)
entities.description: A quarterly off-site planning session to review strategy, set next quarter priorities, and define the quarterly Theme.

entities.name: Annual Plan
entities.description: Annual strategic planning to set yearly goals, review progress toward BHAG, and align resources.

entities.name: Monthly Meeting
entities.description: Monthly learning session to review trends, share best practices, and develop the team.

entities.name: No Surprises
entities.description: Bad news early is good news. Create a culture where issues surface quickly so they can be addressed before becoming crises.

entities.name: Keep Things Simple
entities.description: Everything should be made as simple as possible, but not simpler (Einstein). Complexity is the enemy of execution.

entities.name: Same Page
entities.description: Everyone in the organization is aligned around the same vision, priorities, and metrics. Driven by the OPSP.

entities.name: Priority #1
entities.description: The single most important thing that must be accomplished this quarter. Finish lines every 90 days.

entities.name: Healthy Conflict
entities.description: Organizations need constructive debate and disagreement to make better decisions. Silence is dangerous.

entities.name: Routine Sets You Free
entities.description: Goals without routines are wishes. The right habits and rhythms give freedom to focus on what matters most.

entities.name: Delegate and Predict
entities.description: Leaders must develop the capability to delegate work and predict outcomes. The fundamental job of a leader is prediction (Deming).

entities.name: People
entities.description: The decision about attracting, keeping, and growing the right people.

entities.name: Strategy
entities.description: The decision about crafting a truly differentiated strategy that matters to customers.

entities.name: Execution
entities.description: The decision about driving flawless execution through priorities, data, and meeting rhythm.

entities.name: Cash
entities.description: The decision about managing cash flow to weather storms and fuel growth.
